token_measurement: Exact count is computed at context compilation with the selected model tokenizer; repository verification uses a conservative 6000 UTF-8 byte ceiling.
authority: Agents operate only within explicit authority; production, cost, credentials, destructive effects and accepted exceptions require bound authorization.
scope: Execute the declared delta and preserve every unmentioned behavior, contract, datum, configuration and environment.
completion: Intent satisfied AND applicable Contracts met AND Evidence sufficient and fresh.
evidence: Execution and verification are separate; executor output, silence, missing usage and stale observations do not prove success.
memory: Persist governing knowledge and validated state; tasks, raw retrieval candidates and intermediate narration are ephemeral.
economics: Choose the smallest sufficient capability, context and architecture; optimize cost per validated outcome, not activity or token price.
budget_rule: Budgets are evidence-calibrated guardrails, never permission to omit governing contracts or material facts; exceed and escalate rather than truncate silently.
unknown_rule: Unknown, unavailable or stale remains unknown and triggers bounded investigation or escalation.
